<!-- pr-reviewer: 0c477509a52eb9b8ac5268e00cd7c97d09b097c2 -->
Needs changes before merge. The code is correct. Two items in the PR text and evidence are open.

**What looks good**
- `sinker-edm.mch` is declared `"kind": "sinker_edm"` and has an empty `edm` section. No `edm.codes` ships. The sinker post "Sinker EDM (ISO)" is its only post (`posting::SINKER_POSTS`).
- The post refuses by name until the user fills `edm.codes`. The test `sinker_burn::the_shipped_sinker_template_lists_and_refuses_its_unfilled_codes_by_name` pins the entry, the kind, the post and the refusal text "states no edm.codes.".
- The machine kind is declared, never inferred. The check in `machine.rs:774-777` is now `Kind::Plasma | Kind::SinkerEdm | Kind::WireEdm`. The merge of main (244635103) is correct: the remerge-diff shows only the two hand hunks, and both sides are kept.
- The ribbon row (0c477509a) follows the existing guard `every_kind_with_a_shipped_machine_has_a_mode`. The `short_caption` catch-all arm is gone, so a new kind now fails the build instead of showing "Machine". The mode switch uses the undoable `LoadBuiltinMachine`.
- The fixture `crates/app/tests/edm/sinker-edm.mch` is byte-equal to the shipped file, and a test pins that.
- No new `camcraft-*` dependency. No new command, so no new MCP tool is owed (the entry is listed by the existing machine tools). No snapshot PNG changed. No process file changed. The decision file `docs/decisions/1135-sinker-template-library.md` is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1135`. Clean-room: the file has only generic axes and no vendor values.

**Results (locally, in the existing worktree, head contains the merge of main, main has since moved 4 commits; GitHub reports MERGEABLE)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sinker_burn --test machine`: 33 and 15 passed.
- `--test edm_machine --test edm_conditions --test mcp_edit_machine --test carried_fixtures_cache --test wire_post`: 7, 2, 5, 3, 12 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 816 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: I stopped it. It maps about 130 app suites (all that read `app::posting`) and one suite ran very long. No failure showed in the log before the stop. This is not a full pass of that plan.

**Requested before merge**
1. UI screenshots. The PR changes the ribbon mode menu (a sixth row "Sinker EDM") and the library list. The body says screenshots are owed. Add before and after screenshots to the description. The maintainer holds UI PRs without them.
2. Update the PR body. It does not name the ribbon row commit (0c477509a), the `machine_modes.rs` change or the UI tests. It lists only the library entry. Add a short line and put the UI tests under "Tested".

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs` is now 448 lines (426 before) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` is 5316 lines. Both were already over 400. A later split is advised.
- Mounting the template from the ribbon gives a machine whose post refuses until the user adds codes. The decision file states this. The user sees the refusal by name, so no wrong output is possible.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This is a re-check of PR #1753 at head c545e5fc. No new code review ran here.

**Class: SAME.** `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 1753 --reviewed 0c477509a` prints: only merges of the base, with no hand edits. The new head adds a merge of main only. The code review of 0c477509a stands.

**Earlier blockers are resolved.**

1. Screenshots: the body has the "Screenshots" section now. It shows the ribbon before and after, at 1280 px and at 1920 px. It also shows the library list, and the sinker template selected.
2. Body: the body now names the sixth ribbon mode row, the machine-modes change, and the removal of the `short_caption` catch-all arm. The UI tests are under "Tested". The re-run results for this head are in the body.

The body has the `Changelog:` line and its closing keyword for issue 1135. GitHub reports MERGEABLE. No build ran in this re-check. The test and clippy results from the review of 0c477509a, and the re-run note in the body, stand.

**Result: merge-ready.** A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
